mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%) despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in housing starts and retail sales (both above their 3-month moving averages) signals robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery phases, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply capacity, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of post-recession recovery periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1500 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year consumer price inflation rate below 2.0% (derived from CPIAUCSL) indicates favorable monetary conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle economic expansions, a sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 100,000 jobs per month signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of early-cycle expansion periods when PAYEMS > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production and quarterly GDP growth indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 growth are positive.
